# Benchmarks

BlazePlot against uPlot and Chart.js on the same data in Chrome 153, on AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D and AMD Radeon RX 9070. Each number is the median of 7 fresh-page runs, and BlazePlot is shown on both of its rendering engines. Lower is better, except for FPS.

| Scenario | Metric | BlazePlot | BlazePlot (Canvas 2D) | uPlot | Chart.js |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1M line, first render | Ready (ms) | **8.76** | 6.97 | 11.65 | 14.15 |
| 1M line, pan | FPS | **1090** | 831 | 721 | 546 |
| 1M line, live stream | FPS | **1117** | 856 | 737 | 534 |
| 10M line, pan (accelerated dataset) | FPS | **2081** | 1464 | 32.8 | 30.9 |
| 10 series of 100k, pan | FPS | **248** | 154 | 148 | 124 |
| Hover over a 1M line | Hover p50 (ms) | 0.47 | 0.47 | **0.24** | 0.34 |
| Mount and destroy, repeated | Cycle p50 (ms) | 3.46 | 1.63 | **1.69** | 2.21 |

Bold is the best of BlazePlot, uPlot and Chart.js. uPlot is still faster on: hover over a 1M line; mount and destroy, repeated.

All 19 scenarios, every metric with p95 and spread, and the full method are on [Benchmark results](./benchmark-results.md). Reproduce with `bun run bench:compare`.

This page is generated from `benchmarks/latest.json`; do not edit benchmark numbers by hand. To update it, run `bun run bench:compare` and then `bun run docs:readme`.
